comparisons.peer_summary: Merrill Wealth Management revenue of $19.1 billion increased nine percent, primarily driven by higher asset management fees due to higher average equity market valuations and positive AUM flows, as well as higher brokerage fees due to increased transactional volume.
comparisons.comparison: Both Morgan Stanley and Bank of America reported a 9% year-over-year increase in revenues directly linked to transactional activity or volume in their wealth management segments for 2024. MS attributes its 9% growth in transactional revenues specifically to higher client activity in equity-related transactions, while BAC attributes its 9% growth in Merrill Wealth Management revenue to higher brokerage fees resulting from increased transactional volume. Both disclosures highlight equity market strength as a key driver for this activity.

sentences.text: Transactional revenues of $3,864 million in 2024 increased 9% compared with the prior year, reflecting higher client activity particularly in equity-related transactions.

Merrill Wealth Management revenue of $19.1 billion increased nine percent primarily driven by higher asset management fees due to the impact of higher average equity market valuations and positive AUM flows, as well as higher brokerage fees due to increased transactional volume.
